01 / About

Curiosity into perspective.

“Understanding people begins with observing beyond what is said.”

I am an author interested in human behaviour, psychology, and strategic thinking. My interests are shaped by books that examine human nature, influence, relationships, and the decisions people make.

My current writing project is RAZMOR. Alongside writing, I’m developing a creative team and working to strengthen its capabilities and professionalism.
